_comment: SB2-21 goldens, written by hand. Stack and body heights come from Hirose's drawings (sources below); the frames from the stock footprints' own geometry (README, 'Expected frames'); board thickness and positions are fixture choices. Nothing here is computed by Prism.

sources.matedHeight: Hirose EDC-390687-51-77 sheet 1 (DF12NC(3.0)-*DP-0.5V(51)), mated section with DF12N#(3.0)-*DS-0.5V: 3.0 mm, +0.2/-0
sources.successors: Hirose lists DF12NC(3.0)-20DS-0.5V(51) and DF12NC(3.0)-20DP-0.5V(51) as the replacements for DF12C(3.0)-20DS-0.5V(81) and DF12E(3.0)-20DP-0.5V(81) (KiCad's footprints), compatible in mounting, mating and specification

topPoseInBaseFrame._comment: Board frames of CONTRACTS_P2 §14 (z = 0 at the mid-plane). The top board sits directly over the base, unflipped (its receptacles are on its bottom side): 0.8 (half the base) + 3.0 (mated height) + 0.8 (half the top).

mezzanineShifted._comment: The next commit of mezz_top moves J2 +1.5 mm in X. Posed from J1, pair J2 misses by 1.5 mm (SYS-V11 in M3).

pairs._comment: Which connectors mate. edge_a J1 (right-angle header) into edge_b J1 (vertical socket) is the orthogonal assembly; edge_a J2 (right-angle socket) with edge_b J2 (right-angle header) is the coplanar one. KiCad's generic 2.54 mm parts have no manufacturer drawing, so their poses are not goldens here.
